🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Model and actress Kimmarie Johnson, who appeared on Beverly Hills, 90210 and was crowned Miss Pennsylvania USA, has died at 50.

Johnson suffered a heart event at her home in Los Angeles on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. She was taken to Cedars-Sinai Hospital, where doctors diagnosed a heart aneurysm condition. Her niece, Rhonda Scott, told People that Johnson died on Wednesday afternoon, November 4.

Born and raised in Wilkinsburg, Pennsylvania, Johnson moved to Los Angeles as she began booking movie roles. She competed in beauty pageants and was crowned Miss Pennsylvania USA before building a career as a model and actress.

Johnson played Jane in a 1998 episode of Beverly Hills, 90210. Her other screen credits included the Pamela Anderson series V.I.P., the 2000 comedy Dude, Where's My Car?, Wanda at Large, and the comedy Spanish Fly. Her last listed acting appearance was in the 2017 series Tucker's War.

Beyond acting, Johnson worked as a producer and a beauty director for a fashion magazine, and she founded her own skincare line, SkinGlow by Kimmarie. She is survived by her son, Cameron Nino, a Los Angeles-based musician.

Rest in Peace, Kimmarie Johnson.

Sources: People, confirming her death through her niece Rhonda Scott; TMZ, first to report the news; Los 40.
